name: Button
desc: Primary action control

name: IconButton
desc: 36px icon-only button

name: Badge
desc: Tinted status label, 12px bold, optional 13px icon

name: Tag
desc: Tiny brand-tinted classifier (11px, 2px radius), e.g

name: Chip
desc: Filter / mode chip; selected fills navy

name: Avatar
desc: Square initials avatar, 4px radius

name: IconBox
desc: Tinted square holding one icon: 42px (22px icon) or 34/30px (15px icon)

name: Card
desc: The one container: white, 1px border, 8px radius, 22px padding, no shadow at rest

name: Icon
desc: Inline Lucide glyph (24 grid, 2px stroke, currentColor)

name: Input
desc: Text input, 40px tall, 14px text, 1px border, 4px radius

name: Textarea
desc: Multi-line input matching Input; vertical resize only

name: Select
desc: Native select styled like Input

name: Field
desc: Label (12px bold) + control + hint or error line

name: Switch
desc: 38×22 toggle, 18px knob; on = ITSO blue

name: Checkbox
desc: Native checkbox with navy accent; supports indeterminate

name: Radio
desc: Native radio with navy accent

name: OptionRow
desc: Bordered row wrapping a radio/checkbox with title, description and trailing slot

name: SegmentedControl
desc: Joined button group for a one-of decision (Keep / Revoke)

name: Combobox
desc: Typeahead: 40px field with search icon; list of avatar rows filtered as you type

name: MultiSelect
desc: Dropdown of checkboxes

name: FileUpload
desc: Dashed drop zone on bg2 (navy tint while dragging) with an accept hint

name: Callout
desc: Inline tinted message with an 18px icon: the rule and its consequence in one or two sentences

name: NotificationBanner
desc: Full-width notice under the band: tint bg, bottom hairline, bold lead-in, optional action, always dismissible

name: NotificationPanel
desc: The list the bell opens: 340px white card, unread count, "Mark all as read", rows with a 34px IconBox, orange unread dot, 12px meta and a View link.

name: Toast
desc: Bottom-centre navy toast, white 14px semibold, no icon or close button; ~3.6s

name: EmptyState
desc: Centred 30px icon, bold title, one-line body, optional action

name: Modal
desc: 480px dialog (lg 560) on a 45% navy scrim

name: Drawer
desc: Right-hand 480px side panel on the navy scrim for details that should not leave the list

name: Tooltip
desc: Navy hover tooltip, 12px white text

name: Progress
desc: bar: 6px pill (170px) with ITSO-blue fill

name: Skeleton
desc: Shimmering placeholder bars (1.6s, off under reduced-motion)

name: Spinner
desc: ITSO-blue ring, 24px

name: TopBand
desc: 60px HKUST-navy band: white lockup (34px) left, unit block after a 1px 40%-white rule, tools and user right

name: Sidebar
desc: 248px white rail under the band

name: PageHead
desc: Sticky white header under the band: 20px title, 14px muted subtitle, optional right actions

name: Tabs
desc: Underline tabs for switching content panes of one record

name: Breadcrumb
desc: 12px trail with 13px chevrons; the current page in navy bold

name: Pagination
desc: Numbered pager in ghost-button style, 32px squares; active = brand-light

name: DropdownMenu
desc: White popover (1px border, 4px radius, shadow-lg, min 250) with an optional uppercase heading

name: Table
desc: Data table: 11px uppercase header on pale grey, 14px cells, hover rows, emphasis column bold navy

name: KeyValueList
desc: Definition rows: 150px muted semibold key, 14px value (may be a Badge), 7px rows with hairlines.

name: StepTracker
desc: Approval route: 30px state dots joined by 3px bars

name: ActivityList
desc: Audit / activity rows: 150px grey timestamp (DD Mon YYYY HH:MM), 14px body, 12px muted meta.

name: StatTile
desc: Stat card: gold eyebrow, 32px bold number (unit muted), 12px caption, optional link action, tinted IconBox right

name: KpiDelta
desc: KPI change pill with a trending glyph

name: BarChart
desc: Dependency-free SVG bars in the brand series with hover tooltips

name: LineChart
desc: Dependency-free SVG lines: 2px strokes, white-filled dots, faint area under the first series, legend when more than one series

name: Accordion
desc: Bordered card of Disclosure rows, one open at a time; chevron rotates 180° in 150ms
